# Clip Studio Editor

Read `docs/07-CLIP-STUDIO-UX.md`. Model video, audio, captions, B-roll, effects and brand overlay tracks. Never mutate generated originals. Use validated allow-listed operations, optimistic draft versions, source maps and deterministic undo/redo. AI must not emit executable code or raw FFmpeg commands.
